entry.title: idempotency, revisited
entry.content:
Short post: idempotency is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Idempotency shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: on idempotency
entry.content:
Every few months idempotency bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Idempotency shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
